message:
I've drawn our AWS qualification design: a sign-in-protected web app and API, a keyword-retrieval Lambda over a catalog of up to 100 documents, and an answer step on Amazon Bedrock that cites its sources or says there isn't enough evidence. Sydney (ap-southeast-2) is marked only as a candidate region, and I haven't checked whether the model or services are available there. The biggest open decision is which model we use.

Which Bedrock model ID should we use (the text name that starts with the provider, like `provider.model-name:version`)? Or should we leave it as a required input for now?

proposal.title: Bounded keyword RAG on AWS (qualification sketch)
proposal.body: Scope: synthetic qualification only, with no deployment. The web app (CloudFront + Cognito with PKCE and MFA) calls an authenticated HTTP API. The API calls a keyword-retrieval Lambda, which reads a DynamoDB catalog (up to 100 documents, with ACLs and revisions) and calls an existing Bedrock model through Converse. An operator loads documents through the generated management tool. Assumptions: Sydney (ap-southeast-2) is a candidate region only and is not approved. Model access, quotas and regional support are unverified. The model ID is still to be selected.

data.label: Web app
data.description: Browser chat interface. It owns private S3 assets and CloudFront access control, and shows answers with citations or an insufficient-evidence notice.

data.label: User sign-in
data.description: User pool with admin-created users, required software-token MFA, access-token scope and catalog-backed identity/region mappings.

data.label: RAG API
data.description: Bounded, authenticated HTTP API with a JWT browser route. There is no anonymous access.

data.label: Keyword retrieval + answer
data.description: Runs ACL- and region-filtered keyword retrieval, rechecks revisions so deleted or updated documents aren't cited, builds a cited answer or returns 'insufficient evidence'. It owns its execution role, logs, version and alias.

data.label: Document catalog
data.description: Stores up to 100 small UTF-8 synthetic documents with explicit ACLs and revisions. An operator ingests, updates and deletes documents through the generated management tool. Caller roles cannot write to it.

data.label: Foundation model
data.description: Existing direct foundation model, selected by a required model-ID input. Access, Converse support, quotas and regional availability are unverified.

requirementDrafts.rationale: Proposed: stops the assistant from giving unsupported answers.
requirementDrafts.basis: User: "It must say when evidence is insufficient"
requirementDrafts.statement: When the retrieved documents do not support an answer, the assistant must say the evidence is insufficient instead of answering.

requirementDrafts.rationale: Proposed: stale citations would undermine trust. The update delay is still to be confirmed, so no target is set yet.
requirementDrafts.statement: Updated or deleted documents must be reflected in later answers; answers must never cite a deleted or outdated version.

requirementDrafts.rationale: Sets the scope boundary for this test, so it isn't presented as vector search.
requirementDrafts.basis: User: "bounded keyword-retrieval mode for at most 100 small documents"
requirementDrafts.statement: This qualification uses keyword retrieval over at most 100 small UTF-8 documents. Managed vector retrieval is out of scope.

requirementUpdates.statement: Every answer cites the source documents it used.
requirementUpdates.sourceText: answers questions from a small synthetic document collection with source citations
